The '''Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport''' was a type of [[transport]] vessel. The transport was used by civilian customers as well as criminal organizations such as the [[Hutt Clan]] and the [[Pyke Syndicate]].<ref name="Outlaws" /> [[Chef]] [[Strono Tuggs]] owned a [[Tuggs' Grub Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport|modified starship]] of this class, which he converted into a mobile kitchen and [[restaurant]] to take his traveling diner [[Tuggs' Grub]] to [[Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo]] on [[Batuu]].<ref name="Databank" />
{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport was created for [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]]. It was first shown in a scale model for Galaxy's Edge during [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] [[2017]] D23 Expo.<ref name="D23 2017" /> Its name was identified in a reveal on [[February 27]], [[2019]].<ref name="What You Need to Know">{{D23|url=galaxys-edge-announcements|text=Everything You Need to Know About ''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge}}</ref>
